gen-gf-shantell-sans-instrument-sans: Instrument Sans reads as modern, pincer-open c tips under Shantell Sans. Shantell Sans then holds a tin-can mouth and one nib width over that unvarying plain sans.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-mulish: Shantell Sans cuts a tin-can mouth on a fixed nib over Mulish. And Mulish holds horseshoe apertures, a sans-serif with no thick-and-thin shift under that display shout.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-poppins: A tin-can mouth on one nib width marks Shantell Sans on the heading. Running copy in Poppins stays easy, rope-loose curves and a sturdy lowercase through a full column.
gen-gf-sintony-fs-erode: Erode opens the g and a under Sintony, a plier-jawed c against slightly slimmer horizontals in the serif. Sintony shrinks into fuss, while Erode still reads.
gen-gf-six-caps-fs-erode: Erode reads as editorial serif, a gentle ebb of weight under Six Caps. And Six Caps does the almost-merging pairs best, while Erode holds the open g through copy.
gen-gf-six-caps-fs-karma: Six Caps almost merges letter pairs over Karma, a high waist on the heading line. Karma's terminals finishing away from the stem against that squeezed heading is the spark.
gen-gf-slabo-13px-fs-merriweather-sans: Wide openings on small letters mark Slabo 13px over Merriweather Sans. And running copy stays sturdy, with an e that opens clearly right through a full column.
gen-gf-sniglet-inter: Uncurled terminals on a level beat mark Sniglet on the heading. Inter then holds hollow-reed counters and a tube-like line through a full column of plain sans.
gen-gf-sniglet-mulish: Commanding Sniglet keeps a level beat, terminals that stop short of curling in. And Mulish holds horseshoe apertures, a plain sans with no thick-and-thin shift under that display shout.
gen-gf-sniglet-poppins: Poppins reads as modern sans-serif, rope-loose curves under Sniglet's uncurled terminals on the heading. Poppins likes a modest size so those unknotted curves stay easy through copy.
gen-gf-sofia-sans-fs-erode: Contemporary Sofia Sans traces each letter at one weight, e never a blot. And a longer stretch of Erode stays easy, a gentle ebb of weight under the heading.
gen-gf-sofia-sans-fs-karma: Sofia Sans traces each letter at one weight over Karma, e never mistaken for a blot. Constant heading ribbon against Karma's robust downstrokes is the spark.
gen-gf-sofia-sans-condensed-fs-karma: Logs-in-a-boom crowding marks Sofia Sans Condensed over Karma on the heading. Constant heading thickness against Karma's softly varied strokes is what stands out in the text serif.
gen-gf-sofia-sans-extra-condensed-fs-bes: High-waisted crowding marks Sofia Sans Extra Condensed over Bespoke Slab on the heading. And Sofia Sans Extra Condensed does the jammed shout best, while Bespoke Slab holds outsized lowercase.
gen-gf-sofia-sans-extra-condensed-fs-lit: Literata reads as bookish, wide unclosed mouths under Sofia Sans Extra Condensed. Stencil-cut heading strokes then sit against Literata's moderate thickness shift through running copy on the sheet.
